_: Unova's story key items (the owner's rule, 2026-10-16: what a scene hands you goes in the Bag, a keepsake with no use), both parts of the Journey (src/a4e_unova.js). Items the game has no Bag item for (Poké Balls, Max Revives, Protein...) are keepsakes too, as Kanto's Poké Balls are. Icons: resources/sprites/items; the C-Gear, Running Shoes, Colress Machine, Iron Key and DNA Splicers have none in the pack.

un_xtransceiver.d: The video phone Mom gave you in Nuvema Town, so you can call Cheren and Bianca wherever you go.

un_pokeballs.d: The five Poké Balls Professor Juniper gave you on Route 1, after showing you how to catch a Pokémon.

un_runningshoes.d: Mom brought them to the Accumula Town gate, so you could keep up with Bianca.

un_cgear.d: Fennel's wireless device, your thanks for the Dream Mist in the Dreamyard. Two years later Bianca gave you a new one in Aspertia City.

un_healballs.d: Three Heal Balls from the little girl whose Pokémon you won back from Team Plasma in Wellspring Cave.

un_ultraballs.d: The ten Ultra Balls Professor Juniper gave you and Cheren in the gate to Nimbasa City.

un_bicycle.d: The Day-Care Man's thank-you, after you saved his Pokémon from Team Plasma in Nimbasa City.

un_oldgateau.d: The cake Cedric Juniper gave you at the foot of Dragonspiral Tower, before you went in after Team Plasma.

un_lightstone.d: Kept in the Nacrene Museum all along, with Reshiram asleep inside it. In N's Castle it woke.

un_fullrestore.d: Bianca's gift on Route 8, after your battle by the Tubeline Bridge.

un_maxrevives.d: Three from Bianca on Route 10, before Victory Road; two years later, three more from Rood in the Giant Chasm.

un_superrod.d: Looker's gift in Nuvema Town, when he asked you to help find the Seven Sages.

un_ragecandybar.d: Professor Juniper's gift at Relic Castle: an old Mahogany Town sweet that wakes the Darmanitan statues.

un_biancaballs.d: The ten Poké Balls Bianca gave you in Aspertia City, two years after your first journey, with your new Pokédex.

un_protein.d: Colress's thank-you on Route 4 for the data from your battle.

un_lunarwing.d: From the girl in the Strange House on the way to Lentimas Town. On Marvelous Bridge it called down Cresselia.

un_colressmachine.d: Colress's device, given on Route 22. It woke the Crustle blocking Seaside Cave, then sparked and broke.

un_ironkey.d: It came with Regirock in the Underground Ruins, and opened the Iron Chamber, where Registeel waited.

un_darkstone.d: N's gift in his castle, two years on. At the top of Dragonspiral Tower it woke as Zekrom.

un_dnasplicers.d: Kyurem left them behind in the Giant Chasm. With them it can join with Zekrom again.
